context: Two teens debrief an awkward club introduction
purpose: Teach: さておき/おもう/あがる/はずし/内心/さわやか/ネガティブ/交わし

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、さっきの自己紹介で緊張であがるタイプだったよね？
lines.en: Hey, during that intro you're the type who freezes up from nerves, right?
lines.style: Casual teen girl tone, teasing but warm overall

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: やめてよ…内心ずっとドキドキしてたんだから。
lines.en: Don't remind me… my heart was pounding the whole time inside.
lines.style: Embarrassed teen boy, slightly whiny defensive tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でもさ、部長とちゃんと言葉を交わしてたじゃん、えらい。
lines.en: But you actually exchanged words with the captain, that's impressive.
lines.style: Encouraging teen girl with casual praising warm tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いや、完全に話のピントをはずしたし、笑われたと思う。
lines.en: No way, I totally missed the point and got laughed at.
lines.style: Self-deprecating teen boy, mumbling slightly under breath

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そんなネガティブにならないでよ、みんな優しかったでしょ？
lines.en: Don't go all negative on me, everyone was nice, right?
lines.style: Cheerful teen girl pushing back gently but firmly

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まあ、先輩のさわやかな笑顔にちょっと救われたかも。
lines.en: Well, the senior's refreshing smile kind of saved me, maybe.
lines.style: Softening teen boy with hesitant admission tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ほら！それはさておき、明日の練習どうする？
lines.en: See! Anyway, putting that aside, what about practice tomorrow?
lines.style: Bright teen girl shifting topic energetically and quickly

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うーん、正直さぼりたいって、ふとそうおもう瞬間ある。
lines.en: Hmm, honestly, I sometimes suddenly think I want to skip it.
lines.style: Lazy honest teen boy with drawn-out casual delivery
